observation: Fresh main exposed truncation for the bounded top-level and extension summary views, but equal-ranked rows still inherited manifest enumeration order. Reversing the same manifest changed both bounded summaries, so equivalent repository reality could produce different cognition inputs across filesystem enumeration orders.

decision_provenance.route_basis: The defect is singular, directly falsifiable, adjacent to the just-closed bounded-summary truth markers, and requires only deterministic tie-breaking without prescribing a new context-selection architecture. The four-mode contract therefore resolves to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT without forced rotation.

pre_fix_reproduction: A synthetic 90-file manifest spanning 90 top-level roots and 20 extensions produced different topLevel and extensions bounded views when the exact same entries were reversed. The new regression failed before the change.
change: Preserve extension frequency as the primary ordering but use extension name as a deterministic tie-breaker, and sort the observed non-credential top-level roots lexically before the existing 80-entry bound.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: EXPECTED FAILURE reproduced: reversed enumeration changed bounded summary contents/order

truth_boundary: This makes the already-observed bounded summary deterministic for equivalent manifest sets. It does not expand manifest coverage, choose an optimal large-repository sampling policy, implement parser-grade module resolution, or solve arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
